cases.name: tokens_not_a_list
empty_expression
non_string_token
unknown_token
cases.code:
out = []
for toks, i in [(['2', '--4', '+'], 1), (['2', '1.5', '+'], 1), (['', '2', '+'], 0),
                (['2', ' 3', '+'], 1), (['2', '3a', '+'], 1), (['2', '3', '%'], 2),
                (['2', '+3.0', '+'], 1)]:
    try:
        sol.eval_rpn(toks)
        out.append('no error')
    except Exception as e:
        msg = str(e)
        out.append((type(e).__name__, 'unknown token' in msg, ('token %d' % i) in msg))
result = out

cases.name: stack_underflow
division_by_zero
leftover_and_scan_order
no_import_no_eval
cases.code:
import ast
src = open(sol.__file__).read()
tree = ast.parse(src)
imports = any(isinstance(n, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)) for n in ast.walk(tree))
banned = set()
for n in ast.walk(tree):
    if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id in ('eval', 'exec', 'compile', '__import__'):
        banned.add(n.id)
result = (imports, sorted(banned))
